skills.reason: Next-attack-only consumption, guaranteed hit/crit, stun timing and refresh semantics lack a verified implementation.
Direct ally health damage, protection and Death's Door behavior need engine evidence; bleeding is not a substitute.
Party max-health cost and independent enemy stun resolution need verified target and damage semantics.
Reliable same-round extra action for another hero, direct self-damage and recipient action limits remain unverified.
Skill-triggered persistent two-actions-per-round with next-round start and combat-end reset is not proven by constant hero initiative or a one-time action effect.

runtime_checks: Mark application after a hit, duration and resistance behavior.
Group shuffle executes at most once per cast, including mixed hit/miss results and multi-rank enemies.
All-in self stress is paid exactly once on hit or miss.

Camping: party stress heal has reference precedent (tomori/anon); NEGATIVE stress_heal_amount (under_mask +10 stress) has NO precedent and is experimental. Quest-end buff lifetime and repeated-camp/multiple-Sakiko stacking. Refresh-only is NOT implemented by the reference buff schema.
Class-specific camp and trinket loading, upgrade prerequisites, and English/Chinese display in the actual game.
